title: Steampunk Airship Girl
description: A young woman with long flowing brown hair and goggles stands on the wooden balcony of a massive steampunk mechanical airship. The vessel features a giant glowing green circular eye at its center, metallic pipes, and rotating elements, floating high above a cloudy sky with a distant silhouetted city below.
